title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I'm keeping an eye on our surroundings. So far everything seems fine.

title: Talk 1
original: You should know that some of those eyes on you hold nothing but malice. You're not safe, not even at Rhodes Island.

title: Talk 2
original: Don't be afraid of those hostiles hiding in the shadow. No matter how those criminals try to hide, they can't escape my eyes.

title: Talk 3
original: I'll have my revenge... even if I must lose my life for it.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My clan, my friends, they all perished in the woods of our hometown... The only ones who mourned them were the trees, which gave unto them their leaves.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: This crossbow is manufactured for the sole purpose of punishing sinners. The day will come when I use it to pass my final judgement on those who deserve it.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Meteorite... we used to be friends. On the day my hometown was destroyed, we were part of the small group that managed to escape.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Since then, I've never stopped searching for the traitor who led the rebel army to our town. Could it be Meteorite? No, I... It couldn't be her...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, I've been spending more time patrolling these days... It's fine, you say? But... um, thank you for caring.

title: Idle
original: I'd like to take a nap...

title: Onboard
original: Firewatch here. I'm a sniper. To avenge my fallen clan, I need all the power I can get.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I need more power...

title: Promotion 1
original: Thanks for appointing me to this position.

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you for the promotion. I hope you'll keep using my powers for the right thing. If you don't, however...

title: Added to Squad
original: The team is complete.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Got it.

title: Depart
original: All Operators, get ready!

title: Begin Operation
original: Enemies spotted. Taking action.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Understood.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Awaiting instructions.

title: Deployment 1
original: Searching for enemies.

title: Deployment 2
original: I am in position.

title: In Battle 1
original: Laying suppressive fire.

title: In Battle 2
original: Target locked.

title: In Battle 3
original: Strike inbound.

title: In Battle 4
original: Firing!

title: 4-star Result
original: I'm not done until I have my revenge...

title: 3-star Result
original: All targets eliminated. Mission complete.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Mission accomplished, request search for remaining hostiles.

title: Operation Failure
original: Retreating... immediately...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I'm not used to being in a room with so many people...

title: Tap
original: Huh!?

title: Trust Tap
original: Uh, please don't touch my antlers... it tickles...

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's? It's noisy, but I remember days like this back in the forest. We used to sing around the campfire, give each other bracelets weaved from vines... Do you want to hear the songs of my homeland? I've never forgotten them.

title: Greeting
original: Huh? Oh, it's you, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: You want to hear my harmonica? Fine. What are you in the mood for?… Calm and leisurely… Alright, here's a little tune called 'Greenleaves.'

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Today will be noisy. I think I'll find a quiet place to hide. Have fun with Meteorite and the others.
